author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Our Batmobile collection grows! Adam and Norm unbox a 1/6 scale replica of the batmobile from the 1966 Batman television show. This model, made by Jazzinc Dioramas, is actually based on the 1968 version of the vehicle, with subtle differences in paint scheme and tweaked details from the original car. But its iconic silhouette and array of gadgets paved the road for the film and TV Batmobiles that followed. 

Learn more about Jazzinc Dioramas here: https://jazzincdioramas.com/ and https://www.facebook.com/JazzincDioramas/ 
Other Batman 1/6 vehicles and figures: https://jazzincdioramas.com/batman
Disclosure: This product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review. 

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
